harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured persistent daily rotation for `/var/log/inventory/app.log`: seven compressed rotations with `copytruncate`. Verified open-file writing, retention, gzip integrity, cron scheduling, and persistence through a node restart. CentOS 5.11 and kernel 2.6.18-398.el5 remain unchanged.
actions_performed: Validated the rule using the installed legacy-compatible logrotate 3.7.4.
Forced rotations to prove open-descriptor writing and exact seven-archive retention.
Restarted node1 safely and verified recovery and configuration persistence.

evidence.requirement: Daily rotation with seven compressed archives
evidence.summary: Shows the active rule, successful parser validation, exactly seven valid gzip archives, and no eighth archive.

evidence.requirement: Application can continue writing after rotation
evidence.summary: A held-open descriptor wrote after forced rotation; the inode remained unchanged, old content was compressed, and post-rotation content reached the active log.

evidence.requirement: Keep installed operating-system release and kernel
evidence.summary: CentOS 5.11 and kernel 2.6.18-398.el5 were identical before and after the work and restart.
Captures the healthy baseline and old boot ID, restart acknowledgement, changed boot ID, and recovered crond, persisted rule, seven valid archives, and successful post-restart application-log write.
